decision: Require request identities observed in attested Qubes qualification evidence to be unique across independent campaign runs.
problem: Unique run IDs do not prove independent executions if two runs reuse the same durable requestId. Reuse can cause journal reconciliation or cached responses from one run to satisfy another and overstate multi-run reliability evidence.

reviews.reason: Qualification claims independent executions, so durable request identities must not overlap across run boundaries.

reviews.preferred: fail closed on any cross-run requestId reuse
reviews.reason: Prevents stale or replayed durable request state from being counted as fresh qualification evidence.
Adds no qrexec calls and only linear memory/time in observed request IDs; avoids changing coordinator persistence or transport semantics.

alternatives.rejected: runId is evidence metadata and does not namespace durable request journal identities.
Destroys the persistence/recovery conditions the qualification is intended to exercise and increases operational risk.

alternatives.approach: Namespace request IDs inside coordinator persistence
alternatives.rejected: Stronger structural isolation but changes production persistence semantics and has higher regression risk; the harness already supports run-scoped identities.

winner.approach: attested evaluator cross-run request uniqueness check
winner.resources: O(number of observed request IDs) local memory/time
winner.qa: negative test reuses one requestId across distinct runIds; positive test uses separate request IDs

lesson: Independent campaign labels are insufficient when durable idempotency/reconciliation keys can still alias across runs. Qualification independence must include durable identity independence.
